This endpoint initializes Report Access. For step-by-step instructions on using the Historical Metrics API refer to the [CC Historical Analytics Summary Report](/analytics/docs/cc-historical-analytics-summary-report) Guide. A report can be either defined as grouping, filtering, metrics, time interval, or another type.

**Script Paths variant** (`type: script-paths`, v8+) uses a dedicated request shape (`ScriptPathsReportDefinitionRequest`). See [Script Paths Report](/analytics/docs/cc-historical-analytics-summary-report#9-script-paths-report) in the guide for its request shape, restrictions, and CSV output format.
